summary: Astral Healthcare is an autonomous, cross-platform health-monitoring web application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. It equips space crews with real-time biometric tracking, interactive anatomical diagnostics, and automated space-hazard triage against key spaceflight risks like radiation, bone loss, and cardiovascular events. Because deep-space missions involve significant communication delays with Earth, astronauts must proactively manage their health. Astral Healthcare addresses this by translating complex telemetry into instant, actionable countermeasures, empowering astronauts to independently evaluate health statuses, protect their well-being, and ensure mission success.
details: It collects users' data and assess acquired data based on standard health measurements. The site will display the health state of the user while also providing information about the environment hazards. I hope that by participating in this hackathon, I can gain more experience and build new creations as well. I used Gemini's assistance in creating this website, although I planned and designed the layout myself.
